camel_example: aliyun devops PUT /api/v4/projects/889910/merge_requests/1 --region cn-hangzhou --organizationId 5ebbc0228123212b59xxxxx --accessToken f0b1e61db5961df5975a93f9129d2513 --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body {"description":"test-描述信息","title":"test-更新标题"}
description_en: This API only supports updating the title and description of a merge request
description_zh: 该API仅支持修改合并请求的标题和描述信息
name: UpdateMergeRequest

parameters.help_en: The ID of the organization. You can find the organization ID in the URL of the organization's page on Alibaba Cloud DevOps, such as `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS)
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The local ID of the merge request, which is a sequential ID unique within a repository
parameters.help_zh: 合并请求局部ID，表示代码库下的第几个合并请求
parameters.name: local_id

parameters.help_en: The new title of the merge request
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The new description of the merge request
parameters.name: description
